card.name: Punctuation before stomach symptom words
card.fires_on: Commas, brackets and small linking words (of, for, as) right before an expected stomach or nausea term such as nausea, vomiting, or dyspepsia. The setting is a list or phrase about gastrointestinal complaints.

modes.label: Commas in symptom lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of stomach symptoms, just before the next symptom.
modes.example: GI side effects include stomach pain, heartburn<<,>> nausea, vomiting, and gross GI bleeding

modes.label: Linking words before stomach terms
modes.description: A small word such as for, of or as that leads into a stomach complaint.

modes.label: Opening bracket after gut problems
modes.description: A bracket that opens a list of symptoms after gastrointestinal disturbances.
